title: Getters and Setters: Manage Attributes in Python
description: Learn what Python getter and setter methods are, why properties are usually the better choice, and when getters and setters still make sense.
summary: Getter and setter methods allow you to access and mutate non-public attributes while maintaining encapsulation . In Python, you’ll typically expose attributes as part of your public API and use properties when you need attributes with functional behavior.
takeaways: Object-Oriented Python Live Course: Want to practice properties and class design in a real project?
In Real Python’s Object-Oriented Python live course, you build a complete simulator with an instructor, adding properties, data classes, and other OOP tools only when the design needs them.
